title: The Beast
subtitle: The hunger beneath creation
description: Older than the current firmament and younger than every fear, the Beast is an absence that learned appetite. It does not destroy matter; it removes the meaning that lets matter belong to the world.

sections.title: First Manifestation
sections.body: Its earliest footprint appears in the Verdant Catacombs, where an entire dynasty survives in portraits but nowhere in written history.

sections.title: Known Nature
sections.body: Fragments disagree whether the Beast is an enemy, a failed throne, or the universe correcting an ancient excess.
